chunks: By this chain of narration, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Zurara, from 'Isa ibn 'Abdullah al-Hashimi, from his father, from his grandfather, from 'Umar ibn Abi Salama, from his mother Umm Salama (may God be pleased with her). She said: I heard the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) say:
'Ali ibn Abi Talib and the Imams from his descendants after me are the masters of the people of Earth and the Leaders of the bright-faced and shining believers on the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.الْغُرِّ الْمُحَجَّلِينَ: Those with glowing faces and shining limbs from the effects of ritual purification (wudu), distinguished on the Day of Resurrection
key_terms.سَادَةُ: Masters, lords, leaders — those who possess authority and excellence

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about 'Ali and the Imams being leaders on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declares, through a chain transmitted by his wife Umm Salama, that 'Ali ibn Abi Talib and the Imams from his lineage are the masters and leaders of humanity in this world and in the Hereafter. The phrase 'leaders of the al-Ghurr al-Muhajjalin' refers to those who will be distinguished on the Day of Resurrection by radiance on their faces and limbs as a result of their acts of worship (particularly wudu). This hadith is significant as it establishes the spiritual authority of the Imams across both worlds, reported by one of the most eminent female companions of the Prophet.

en.bilal-muhammad: By this isnad from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa from Muhammad b. Sinan from Muhammad b. `Abdullah b. Zurara from `Isa b. `Abdullah al-Hashimi from his father from his grandfather from `Umar b. Abi Salama from his mother Umm Salama (ra). She said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (s) say:
`Ali b. Abi Talib (as) and the Imams from his descendants after me are the masters of the people of Earth and the Leaders of the shining believers on the Day of Resurrection.
